name: com.optimizely.ab.android.datafile_handler.DatafileRescheduler
description: Optimizely's Feature Experimentation SDK runs this Receiver after the phone restarts or the app is replaced to restore background updates to experiment settings. On Android 8 and later, the system job scheduler handles this rescheduling.
disableEffect: On older Android versions, Optimizely may not resume background experiment-setting updates after a restart or app update, leaving remotely controlled app behavior out of date.
